name: Robe

components.headwear: a sheer {{PRIMARY}} veil falling from a slim {{METAL}} crown of thorns, lifted away from the face
components.jewelry: {{METAL}} reliquary pendant on a long chain, stacked rings on every finger, {{METAL}} cuffs engraved with runes
